purpose: Separate how many global integration slots exist from where they occur after every sequence operator is fixed.

evidence_basis.supported: middle attention improves long-document integration, final attention exposes distant content to output, two slots combine those roles, and five distributed slots improve retention at higher cost
evidence_basis.limitation: one seed, 32M-token continuation, RoPE/scope intervention, internal retrieval only

evidence_basis.supported: writer-reader freshness and route/payload composition depend on placement; distance four fails where adjacent refresh passes
evidence_basis.limitation: reader topology is rejected and cannot serve as this study's parent

evidence_basis.supported: a 15-recurrent/5-global layout makes 3:1 credible and operationally simple
evidence_basis.limitation: Kimi's scale, training horizon, MLA, and whole-system success do not establish Speck's optimal ratio

ordered_prerequisites: select KDA or another recurrent operator
select exact cache representation, HCA, CSA, and raw-local formulations
qualify every ratio arm for correctness, state, prefill, decode, and export
freeze count analysis before ratio outputs and placement analysis only after count selection on independent cells

ratio_correction.problem: 20 layers cannot contain 2.5 global layers, so an exact 7:1 recurrent/global ratio is not representable
ratio_correction.rule: report integer counts and realized ratios; never round a non-integral layer allocation while retaining its nominal ratio label

fixed: selected sequence operators and their internal geometry
standard residual and dense FFN formulation
tokenizer, data, sequence length, optimizer, and evaluation
ratio_isolation.placement_rule: for n global slots in L=20 layers, use zero-based indices floor((i+1)*L/n)-1 for i=0..n-1
ratio_isolation.matching: match active non-embedding parameters within 0.025% using uniform FFN width where possible; report exact analytic FLOPs and add a batch-aligned fixed-FLOP view rather than forcing both matches with hidden interventions
ratio_isolation.selection: choose the lowest-cost count passing every quality/capability constraint; if multiple pass, use realized state, time-to-quality, prefill, and decode Pareto dominance

placement_successor_after_ratio.reason: integration-heavy and readout-heavy layouts require an integer selected count; mixing two-slot and five-slot layouts would reintroduce the ratio confound
required_templates: integration-heavy placement with the final readout slot retained
readout-heavy placement with at least one middle integration slot retained

role_constraints.integration: at least one slot in the middle half of depth
role_constraints.readout: the final logical layer remains a global slot
role_constraints.refresh: report maximum and distribution of recurrent depth between global updates

placement_successor_after_ratio.rule: freeze exact indices, parameter geometry, and analysis in a successor contract after count selection and before placement outputs

mechanistic_endpoints: long-document loss change attributable to middle integration
output-side retrieval attributable to final readout
route, payload, and direct composition by layer
KDA decay/overwrite and state update between global slots
attention mass and selected-source recall by slot
hidden-state intervention and logit-lens contribution by depth
quality versus maximum refresh gap rather than nominal ratio alone

quality_and_systems.quality: aggregate and every-source language-loss non-inferiority plus every frozen retrieval/composition floor
quality_and_systems.state: report every recurrent, exact, compressed, sparse, and raw-local state component by layer and length
quality_and_systems.training: fixed-token, fixed-analytic-FLOP, fixed-steady-time, and time-to-locked-quality views
quality_and_systems.serving: prefill, batch-1 decode, maximum-resident-batch decode, and arrival-rate sweeps
quality_and_systems.systems_threshold: the retained lower-cost ratio must clear the applicable 10% simple or 20% custom-runtime primary improvement with five thermally interleaved repeats

decision.next_action: after all operators qualify, materialize geometry-only 1:1, 3:1, and 9:1 arms and run correctness/cost preflight before freezing training
